description: The anchor tool. Give a rough token or call count for your AI session and get an order-of-magnitude CO2e estimate PLUS the real, verifiable ecological work you can provision to answer it on Vealth. Vealth does NOT sell paper offsets — it provisions maintenance of the commons: you fund a bounded work packet keyless from your own wallet; when the retirement lane is running an approved proof queues a carbon retirement with an on-chain retirement certificate (that lane is paused by operator order since 2026-08-04). Call find_work next to pick the work. The estimate is orientation only, never a precise carbon claim, and this server never takes payment or holds a wallet.

calls.description: Or approx number of model calls, if you have no token count.

tokens.description: Approx total tokens this session (input + output).
